channel.title: Fire Engineering Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Fire Engineering Magazine (fireengineering.com)

item.title: Baltimore Firefighters Battle Three-Alarm House Fire
item.description: A three-alarm fire occurred at a St. Paul Street home in Baltimore.

item.title: Push to Ease MA Building Code for Affordable Housing Raises Fire Safety Worries
item.description: Gov. Maura Healey will study updating Massachusetts' building code to allow single-stair mid-rise housing.

item.title: KY Firefighters Rescue Man Stuck on Riverfront Water Feature
item.description: Owensboro firefighters and police rescued a man trapped at Smothers Park's water feature, stabilizing him for transport to the hospital due to traumatic injuries and cold exposure.

item.title: Illegal Subdivision May Have Played Role in NYC Fire That Killed Mom and Baby
item.description: A fire in a Queens building, lacking a permit for a basement apartment, resulted in the deaths of a mother and her newborn, according to officials.

item.title: L.A. Mayor Directed Palisades Fire Damage Control, Email Shows
item.description: Los Angeles city officials, led by Mayor Karen Bass, faced scrutiny over the handling of the Palisades fire after-action report.

item.title: Fighting Complacency and Building Firehouse Culture
item.description: Alex Anthony Seaman is a captain/paramedic with the City of Tamarac (FL) Fire Rescue and an acting battalion chief, bringing 16 years of fire service and emergency medical experience to his leadership role. In this episode of Perspectives on Leadership, Seaman opens up about what drives him every day—from his commitment to his crew to […]

item.title: Surfers Rescue Six After Boat Capsizes off CA Coast
item.description: Surfers in Santa Cruz helped rescue six people from a capsized boat. All passengers were hospitalized but are recovering, officials reported.

item.title: Woman, Up to 40 Cats Die in Devastating PA Hoarding House Fire
item.description: A fire in Edwardsville resulted in the death of a 64-year-old woman and up to 40 cats. The cause is under investigation, with police seeking information from the public.

item.title: Arson Probe Underway After Fire at MO Warehouse Once Tied to ICE Detention Center
item.description: Police are investigating a fire at a Kansas City warehouse, previously considered for an ICE detention center, which was extinguished before spreading. The suspect remains unidentified.

item.title: Not So Fast, My Friends!
item.description: Fleet management is and has always been one of our most mismanaged responsibilities. David Rhodes comments on the ongoing fire apparatus cost conversation.
